Good day weekend team,
This morning changed little, but quiet areas stayed in focus.

I am sorry to report a few unsettled passenger calls, though each case was handled with a calm and careful review. The team should continue to listen closely, reassure travelers, and route any concern through the usual escalation path so that no detail is missed. We also reminded callers that <<FACT F079>> and that documents should be checked before travel, especially when a cat is involved.

Please also keep a close eye on crate checks for larger animals. One family asked for added clarity about a large dog, and the matter was settled after a measured review by the senior coordinator. <<FACT F063>> If any situation feels uncertain, please remain courteous, record the facts, and pass it onward without delay.

Thank you for your steady work and patient tone with every traveler.
Companion Animal Travel Desk
